caps.what: MassDOT reimbursement as a percentage of eligible project costs (80% or $700,000, whichever is less)

match.appliesTo: eligible project costs (MassDOT reimburses at most 80%; the grantee provides the non-IRAP share, a 20% minimum private sector match)
match.quote: verification that the 20% minimum stipulated private sector matching funds were in fact expended on the project.

award.quote: Reimbursement will not exceed 80% or $700,000, whichever is less, for each approved project.

sections.name: Project Need Statement
sections.quote: Project Need Statement - Include a clear and concise statement of the industry transportation logistics problem/product distribution issue(s) that the proposed IRAP project will address and alleviate.

sections.name: Project Description
sections.quote: Project Description - Describe the proposed IRAP project solution to address the needs outlined in Section A.

sections.name: Project Management
sections.quote: Explain how and by whom the requested improvements are planned to be procured and constructed.

sections.name: Project Readiness
sections.component: Project Narrative, Section C (second Section C in the notice)
sections.quote: Project Readiness - Projects should demonstrate readiness to proceed promptly upon execution of the IRAP Grant Agreement and issuance of a Notice to Proceed (NTP).

sections.name: Anticipated Project Public Benefits
sections.quote: Anticipated Project Public Benefits - Discuss the expected IRAP project public benefits.

criteria.name: Improves freight rail transportation and supports the State Rail Plan and state policies
criteria.quote: Project will improve freight rail transportation in Massachusetts and support the Commonwealth of Massachusetts's State Rail Plan, transportation, land use, economic development, and environmental policies.

criteria.name: Project readiness clearly demonstrated
criteria.quote: Project readiness is clearly demonstrated including identification of any pre-construction actions already advanced (i.e., designed, permitted, and with necessary agreements)

criteria.name: Significant public benefits (rail volumes, truck traffic reduction, jobs, goods movement)
criteria.quote: Project application identifies significant public benefits in terms of increased rail volumes, reduction of truck traffic, increased jobs, and the growth of goods movement

criteria.name: Addresses needs and concerns of affected communities, including environmental justice populations
criteria.quote: Project will address the needs and concerns of affected communities including any communities or populations that have faced or are facing environmental justice concerns and/or health disparities.

criteria.name: Public benefits in industry retention, expansion and economic development
criteria.quote: Project application identifies significant public benefits in terms of industry retention and expansion and stimulating economic development.

criteria.name: Strong host railroad servicing commitment and local support
criteria.quote: Supporting documentation reflects a strong servicing commitment by the host railroad, support for the project extends to locally elected officials, abutters, and local economic and community development entities.

criteria.name: Reasonable, complete funding plan and budget with strong private sector support
criteria.quote: Project funding plan and budget are determined to be reasonable and complete and reflect strong private sector support.

criteria.name: Cost effectiveness
criteria.quote: The project demonstrates cost effectiveness, including the relationship between the requested IRAP funding and the anticipated public benefits.

other.item: Project Narrative must not exceed 6 single-spaced pages in 12-point font (Section IX)
other.quote: The project narrative should not exceed 6 single-spaced pages in 12-point font.

other.item: Project Narrative is a 5-page narrative response (Section XII)
other.quote: followed by the 5-page narrative response and Attachments B - E below.

other: Narrative sections must follow the stated sequence; recommended maximum space allowances (may be exceeded as long as the overall narrative limit is not): Project Need Statement 1 page, Project Description 1 page, Project Management 1 page, Project Readiness 2 pages, Anticipated Project Public Benefits 1 page
Italicized narrative instructions do not count toward the narrative page limit; the cover sheet and Attachments A-E are not counted
Application Cover Pages are the first 2 pages of the package, followed by the narrative and Attachments B-E
Submit the complete application in a single email to MassDOTIRAPProgram@dot.state.ma.us; emails with attachments must be less than 23MB
format.quote: The project narrative should not exceed 6 single-spaced pages in 12-point font.

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: host municipalities and their economic development corporations, freight railroads operating in the Commonwealth, and rail shippers/receivers engaged in commercial ventures in the Commonwealth
eligibility.quote: Host municipalities and their economic development corporations, freight railroads operating in the Commonwealth, and rail shippers/receivers engaged in commercial ventures in the Commonwealth are eligible to apply

eligibility.item: Project must be a rail access improvement project serving the rail freight shipping needs of one or more employers in the Commonwealth
eligibility.quote: Projects eligible for IRAP support are rail access improvement projects designed to serve the rail freight shipping needs of one or more employers in the Commonwealth.

eligibility.item: Project must have independent utility; projects that depend on approval or completion of another project are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that depend on the approval or completion of another funded or unfunded project will not be eligible.

eligibility.item: Project and its major reimbursable components must have a minimum 20-year useful life
eligibility.quote: Projects must have a minimum 20-year useful life.

eligibility.item: Project must be ready for construction before the application is complete: fully designed, all environmental permits secured, and real property rights secured
eligibility.quote: Before a grant application is identified as complete, IRAP applicants must demonstrate the project is ready for construction or implementation.

eligibility.item: Project must be of public benefit, with benefit to private parties only indirect and incidental (typical targets: 200+ more annual railcar shipments, 300+ fewer annual interstate truck trips, or 20 added on-site jobs)
eligibility.quote: Each project must be of public benefit, in the public interest, and for a public purpose, and any benefit to private entities or individuals shall be indirect and incidental

eligibility.item: Speculative or confidential projects where shipper/receiver detail cannot be provided are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Funding for speculative or confidential projects where shipper/receiver detail cannot be provided are not eligible.

eligibility.item: Applicant must demonstrate administrative and management capacity to manage the project and meet invoicing, reporting and procurement requirements
eligibility.quote: Applicants must demonstrate that they possess the administrative and management capacity to manage the proposed project and comply with program invoicing, reporting, and procurement requirements.

eligibility.item: Materials, labor or services for IRAP-eligible costs must be procured through an open, competitive procurement process
eligibility.quote: grantees must use and document an open, competitive procurement process to select the vendor that provides the best value for the publicly supported project.

eligibility.item: Projects on an active railroad right of way must comply with the operating railroad's safety requirements and applicable FRA regulations
eligibility.quote: Projects which are located on an active railroad right of way will be required to comply with the operating railroad's safety requirements

eligibility.item: Reimbursable work may not start, and costs incurred before the grant agreement start date are not reimbursable
eligibility.quote: Project expenses incurred prior to the MassDOT grant agreement start date can NOT be reimbursed with IRAP funds.

requiredDocuments.item: IRAP Application Cover Sheet (Attachment A), signed and dated by the authorized signatory
requiredDocuments.quote: Respondents must complete the provided IRAP Application Cover Sheet included as Attachment A. It must be signed and dated by the authorized company or municipal signatory.

requiredDocuments.item: Schedule of Project Activities and Estimated Timelines (Attachment B form)
requiredDocuments.quote: Complete the Project Activities Schedule form (Attachment B). At a minimum, the schedule should include pre-construction milestones such as design completion, permitting, and acquisition of necessary property rights.

requiredDocuments.item: Budget and Budget Narrative (Attachment C form) with detailed estimated costs and justification
requiredDocuments.quote: Complete the Budget/Budget Narrative form (Attachment C). Provide detailed estimated costs for materials and construction components, along with justification and explanation of how these costs were calculated.

requiredDocuments.item: Project Locus Maps, Railroad Valuation Maps, Track Plans and Right of Way Maps (Attachment D)
requiredDocuments.quote: Provide maps clearly indicating the location of the project (include municipality, surrounding and adjacent roads, and project parcels).

requiredDocuments.item: Railroad Service Commitment Letter from the servicing railroad
requiredDocuments.quote: A railroad service commitment letter must be provided that indicates the servicing railroad has participated in or has reviewed the project's design

requiredDocuments.item: Letters of support from businesses impacted by the improvement, indicating their level of commitment
requiredDocuments.quote: Letters of project support from the businesses that will be impacted by the improvement (including an indication of their level of commitment) must be provided,

requiredDocuments.item: Letter of support from the host municipality
requiredDocuments.quote: A letter of support from the host municipality must be provided

requiredDocuments.item: Project plans showing the project is fully designed to industry standards
requiredDocuments.quote: This will be met by providing MassDOT with project plans for review.

requiredDocuments.item: Letter from the grantee's legal and/or engineering representative certifying all required permits have been secured
requiredDocuments.quote: letter from the grantee's legal and/or engineering representative certifying that all permits have been secured.

requiredDocuments.item: Letter from the grantee's legal and/or engineering representative certifying all required real property rights have been secured
requiredDocuments.quote: certifying that all required real property rights have been secured.

requiredDocuments.item: Documentation from the railroad or shipper/receiver supporting projected changes in freight service levels (public benefits)
requiredDocuments.quote: Projected changes in freight service levels will need to be supported by documentation provided by either the railroad or the shipper/receiver documenting the projected changes
